title: Fractions of a whole
goal: I can name halves, thirds, quarters, fifths, sixths and eighths, and find a fraction of an amount.
teach: A fraction shows equal parts of a whole. In ¾ the denominator 4 says the whole is cut into 4 equal parts. The numerator 3 says we take 3 of them. To find ¼ of 20, divide 20 by 4: 5. For ¾ of 20, take 3 of those parts: 3 × 5 = 15.

steps: Divide by the denominator: 12 ÷ 3 = 4. So ⅓ of 12 is 4.

watch: The parts must be equal. A shape cut into 4 unequal pieces does not show quarters.
